data.long_meaning: Name of the Indonesian goddess of the Full Moon. Represents completeness, fullness, and prosperity. The name Purnama carries the meaning “Full Moon” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Bahasa. Parents who choose Purnama usually hope their child will grow to embody full moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Purnama total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Purnama" is of significant cultural importance in Indonesia as it carries the name of the goddess of the full moon. In Indonesian culture, the full moon is celebrated as a symbol of abundance, completeness, and prosperity. The name "Purnama" reflects these cultural values and is often used as a name for children born on a full moon night in the hope for a prosperous and fulfilled life.
data.spiritual_significance: In Indonesian spirituality, the full moon is believed to represent the spiritual energy of the universe at its peak. The name "Purnama" signifies the completeness and fullness of this spiritual energy. It is believed that on the night of the full moon, the veil between the spiritual and physical worlds is at its thinnest, making it an auspicious time for spiritual practices and introspection. The name "Purnama" is a reminder of the divine inspiration and guidance that can be accessed during this time, and it is a source of strength and motivation for those seeking spiritual growth and development.
